purpose: Initial inventory of production-critical static runtime assets (per Tracked Runtime Assets Guard spec §6 + §25). Every entry below is either Git tracked (TRACKED_RUNTIME_ASSET) or deterministically generated before first runtime use (GENERATED_RUNTIME_ASSET). The companion guard scripts/verify-tracked-runtime-assets.mjs verifies (a) manifest validity, (b) file existence, (c) Git tracking, (d) ignore-conflict, (e) static asset location boundary, (f) known critical prompt integrity (delegated to the existing A4 frozen-prompt guard), and (g) anchor registry closure.
boundaryRule: Golden Project Rules != Packaging Production Rules. The 8 entries below are not Golden assets and are not part of the Packaging / Jiuzhou / evaluation boundary. They are production inputs. Their SHA-256 digests are recorded for integrity verification at release time.

assetClassifications.TRACKED_RUNTIME_ASSET: Must exist on disk AND be returned by `git ls-files`. SHA-256 verified.
assetClassifications.GENERATED_RUNTIME_ASSET: Must be created deterministically before first runtime use. V1 declares 0 of these (none of the audited production reads are generation-only); a future P3 / P4 phase may add (e.g. a generated cache).
assetClassifications.USER_DATA: Per-user; not in this inventory. Never required in a fresh install.
assetClassifications.SECRET: Credentials / tokens; never committed. Not in this inventory.
assetClassifications.CACHE: Never source-of-truth. Not in this inventory.
assetClassifications.OPTIONAL_RESOURCE: Production must have an explicit safe fallback if the resource is missing. Not in the current inventory; the smoke runner in apps/web-runtime/scripts/ is the only OPTIONAL candidate and is not production code.
assetClassifications.INVALID_PRODUCTION_DEPENDENCY: Production should not depend on it. Not in the current inventory.

declaredDependencyCoverage.specSection: Tracked Runtime Assets Guard spec §H (Runtime Dependency Declaration Coverage)
declaredDependencyCoverage.purpose: Every static filesystem dependency that production code reads must be either (a) a TRACKED_RUNTIME_ASSET declared in the assets[] section above, (b) classified as GENERATED (a runtime-produced file whose name is in the generatedFileBasenames allowlist), (c) classified as USER_DATA (a per-user / per-project / per-installation path matching a known prefix), (d) classified as SECRET (a credential / key path matching a known prefix), or (e) classified as CACHE (a transient runtime cache matching a known prefix). Anything else is RUNTIME_ASSET_UNDECLARED and fails the guard.
